name: Chicken Teriyaki Crispy Rice Cups
desc: Sushi rice pressed into a muffin tin, frozen, baked crisp, and filled with glossy homemade teriyaki chicken.

source.title: Chicken Teriyaki Crispy Rice Cups
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 1/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts, diced into 1/4 to 1/2 inch pieces
2 tbsp avocado oil, plus avocado oil spray

steps: Cook the sushi rice according to the package directions and let it cool until you can handle it.
Whisk all the teriyaki sauce ingredients together until the cornstarch dissolves.
Heat 2 tbsp avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until mostly cooked, 10 to 12 min.
Add the sauce and cook, stirring, until it thickens and turns glossy and the chicken reaches 165°F, about 5 min. Set aside.

Coat a 12-cup nonstick muffin tin with avocado oil. Fill each cup about 3/4 full with rice. Press a 1/4 cup measure into the center of each to smooth the rice into a cup shape that reaches the top of the tin.
Freeze the tin for about 45 min. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400°F.
Spray the rice cups with avocado oil and bake 20 min.
Spoon the chicken into the cups and bake 10 min more.
Let the cups set in the tin for 10 to 15 min, then run an offset spatula around each one, slide it underneath and lift it out.
Top with spicy mayo, sesame seeds and scallions.
tips: Freezing the shaped rice makes the cups hold and crisp. A nonstick tin helps. Makes 12.
Spicy mayo is mayonnaise (Kewpie if you have it) stirred with sriracha to taste.
